primitive_grammar: XOR fusion using each input coordinate at most once

normal_form.encoding: alpha:{1,...,m}->{0,1,...,n}; alpha(i)=0 means discard, alpha(i)=j means input i contributes to output j
normal_form.matrix_form: M in F2^(n x m), every column is 0 or a standard basis vector e_j
normal_form.closure_proof: Generators have 0/e_j columns; under composition each source column maps to 0 or to one column of the second map, hence remains 0/e_k.
normal_form.generation_proof: For any alpha: delete discarded inputs; permute retained inputs into target-fibre blocks; XOR each block; insert zero outputs for empty fibres.
normal_form.composition: composition of partial functions on basis-index sets
normal_form.dedup: Standard finite partial-function structure represented linearly on F2 basis coordinates; no Enterprise novelty claim.

effectivity_models.zero_support_forward_proof: Every grammar morphism sends 0 to 0, so Z is forward-natural for every generated map.
structural_laws: all declared XOR fusion forward preservation
effectivity_models.matched_model_consequence: Z and A share the same structural maps and satisfy every backward-free forward law, but differ on every nonzero state; therefore no such theory semantically entails nonzero effectivity.

escape_boundary.general_exact_criterion: The zero-support obstruction is crossed exactly when the theory adds some axiom or primitive not satisfied by Z.

minimal_one_premise_mechanisms_in_curren.criterion: some x!=0 has f(x)=0 and E(f(x))=>E(x)
the language itself asserts some E_n(v) with v!=0

escape_boundary.nonexample: Adding copying/diagonal alone breaks the noncopying normal form but remains zero-preserving, so Z still survives.
escape_boundary.stronger_scope: Zero-support independence uses only zero preservation plus forward-positive semantics; it persists even under arbitrary additional zero-preserving linear maps.
